title: Bonus $20 Costco Shop Card for New Gold Star or Business Membership ($65/Year) @ Costco
body:
Deal: Bonus $20 Costco Shop Card for New Gold Star or Business Membership ($65/Year) @ Costco

[MrZ] Is it worth getting a Costco membership or just buying Costco items on Doordash (at slightly higher prices)?
[Lizard Spock] It depends on how you shop and what you shop for. I just pay a family member (that is already a member of Costco) to purchase a $250 gift card for us and then just go once a year for a few speciality items. The savings are no different to buying from half-price specials from other grocery stores.
[jimojr] Without a membership, the prices are a lot higher than in store. With a membership, you will get 15% off, plus you can pay with 10% off DoorDash gift card, which makes it cheaper than buying in store. Unfortunately, there’s no 20% off gift card anymore.
[kaybrr] Why do the staff & customers all look do depressed inside Costco?
[MrZ] Look at the customers who shop there. It's like the third world.
[kaybrr] I went with a friend once, it's a bunch of fat over-consumers who then go and plonk down at the food court to eat a whole pizza before going home to gorge on their over-sized chips
[carrawa] You don't get to supermarkets much do you?
Plus, Costco's are concentrated. So people travel to it from a long way away.
When I used to go, didn't see what you saw. May be you were just looking for it
[MakkhiChoos] I tried applying the voucher and it accepts but discounts it by 1 cent….
Does that mean it’s good to go ahead?
[TheDukeOfNukem] Don't forget to setup auto renew and (instore) claim a $10 voucher for doing so.
Then, don't forget to turn off auto renew too, lol.
THEN, don't forget to go instore and cancel your membership overall on the 364th day of the year for a full refund.
Now they've paid you to use their store, not the other way around.
[Levathian] wait you can cancel and get a refund?????
[carrawa] Is this the usual price?
What are the other membership prices if any?
